AdminSession.description: Browser administrator session. Mutations also require the X-CSRF-Token header.
AdminSession.name: kindle_admin

AssistantBearer.description: Scoped external API token issued by the terminal CLI.

get.description: Return the current briefing, or null. Bearer scope: briefing:read.

post.description: Replace the entire briefing. Bearer scope: briefing:write.

get.description: List deadlines, including archived entries. Bearer scope: deadlines:read.

post.description: Create or synchronize a deadline. Bearer scope: deadlines:write.

delete.description: Delete a deadline. Bearer scope: deadlines:delete.

get.description: Retrieve a deadline. Bearer scope: deadlines:read.

put.description: Update, archive, complete or reopen a deadline. Bearer scope: deadlines:write.

post.description: Create or synchronize a task. Bearer scope: tasks:write.

delete.description: Delete a task. Bearer scope: tasks:delete.

get.description: Retrieve a task. Bearer scope: tasks:read.

put.description: Update a task. Set completed to true or false to complete or reopen it. Bearer scope: tasks:write.
